findings.title: Unsorted previous review is quoted whole under a "found blocking" heading
findings.detail: When the earlier review didn't sort its findings (`review.blocking` is nil/empty), `previous(_:summary:pr:)` falls back to quoting the reviewer's entire summary — including its "Worth doing later" items and the VERDICT line — under the heading "# What Oby's review N … found blocking, quoted" (line 199) and the follow-up prompt's "What it found blocking is quoted in …" (Review.swift:153). The follow-up reviewer is told everything in that file is blocking, even parts the original review explicitly called non-blocking, which can make it re-flag or second-guess things that were never meant to block.

findings.title: A prose paragraph between bullets silently ends the current heading's list
findings.detail:
In `findings`, a non-bulleted, non-indented line that follows a blank line ends the current section (`section = nil`) whenever `last != nil` (lines 300-307). If a reviewer writes explanatory prose between two bullets under the same `Blocking:`/`Worth doing later:` heading (e.g. "Blocking:
- item one

Some context.

- item two"), the second bullet is treated as `unsorted` rather than blocking, even though it's clearly still under the Blocking heading. `decide` stays safe in this case (it defers to the review's own verdict rather than wrongly approving), but `result.blocking` loses that finding, so a follow-up review built from `Review.previous` may not see it quoted explicitly.
